// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-UNPROJECTED-READ
// The exact-match parent lookup R11 permits, written without a projection. It
// returns Parent.familyCode, and reading a family code is signing in as that
// family (amendment C1).
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function parentByEmail(email) {
  return db.parent.findUnique({ where: { email } });
}
